newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Airlines in pact with Indonesia's Garuda.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Airlines in pact with Indonesia's Garuda.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp. said Monday it will form an operational and marketing alliance with Garuda Indonesia Airlines as part of its its long-term growth strategy in Asia.

A memorandum of understanding calls for the carriers to coordinate schedules and connections to link points in Indonesia and North America. The carriers will also share codes and marketing programmes.
Northwest said it will fly three times a week between Seattle, Osaka and Jakarta -- the first service by a U.S. airline to the Indonesian capital.
Northwest serves 14 cities in the Asia/Pacific region.

Northwest's pilots on Sunday agreed with the airline on a package of staffing and compensation programmes under which they will fly beyond the contractual maximum limits in exchange for time-and-one-half premium pay.
Its stock rose 25 cents to $38 on Nasdaq at midday.
